program.name: Push-Pull Pairs
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: An upper day of push-pull supersets, then a leg day of straight sets.
program.about: Two days that train differently. The upper day pairs every press with a row or pull in supersets, so one side rests while the other works; the leg day is straight sets of squats, hinges, lunges and glute work with full rests. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Push-pull supersets / legs in straight sets
